[[Tanzit's Cleaver]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[axe]] dropped by [[Tanzit Razorstone]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 6-28 (Requires 9 [[Axe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Health]] +30
:Lengthens [[Deep Wound]] duration on foes by 33%

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Spiked Axe]].

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Spiked Axe]] from collector [[Klakki the Squire]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Cruel]] [[Axe Haft]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Axe Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*[[Spiked Axe]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], or [[Soros]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Cruel]] [[Axe Haft]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Axe Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Strength and Honor]]" inscription
